subject: ArmVirtPkg: Add library for Arm CCA helper functions
reasons: This commit adds a large new library implementation (ArmCcaLib) with new header and 227-line C source. It is entirely new code, not a transformation of existing code.
Coccinelle requires existing code to match and transform; it cannot be used to author new library implementations.
The change introduces new functions ArmCcaIsRealm() and ArmCcaGetIpaWidth() with no prior pattern in the codebase to replace.
